```python
def get_diff(args: argparse.Namespace, stdout: IO[str], stderr: IO[str]
    ) ->Optional[str]:
    # Generate stub with existing annotations replicated
    original_strategy = args.existing_annotation_strategy
    args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE
    stub_with_existing = get_stub(args, stdout, stderr)
    
    # Generate stub ignoring existing annotations
    args.existing_annotation_strategy = ExistingAnnotationStrategy.IGNORE
    stub_without_existing = get_stub(args, stdout, stderr)
    
    # Restore original strategy
    args.existing_annotation_strategy = original_strategy
    
    if stub_with_existing is None or stub_without_existing is None:
        return None
    
    # Generate unified diff
    original_lines = stub_with_existing.render().splitlines(keepends=True)
    new_lines = stub_without_existing.render().splitlines(keepends=True)
    
    diff = difflib.unified_diff(
        original_lines,
        new_lines,
        lineterm=''
    )
    
    return ''.join(diff)
```
